title: 第387章 高阶神魔族，帝狐
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

秘境小世界，神秘雾气重重笼罩。

肉眼可见的范围内，只有浮在半空中的九层玉台。

在肉眼不可见的重重迷雾之后，此方世界大无边际，一尊高逾万米的恐怖身影支撑着天地。

此身影，呈人类女性形态，身材比例高挑爆炸。

她不是灵兽狐族，但头生一对黑色狐族双耳，眼眸中一片漆黑并生有重瞳，浓密的如瀑黑丝在脑后肆意飞舞。

她一身紧身黑衣，没有丝毫狐族的魅惑，浑身充斥着霸道的神魔之气。

此刻，女人顶天立地，手掌虚托着。

那九层玉台，赫然漂浮在其掌心，如同一个精致的小巧玩物。

而九层玉台上那两道狐影，却渺小得不如半粒微尘。

若迷雾散去，此等惊悚画面，足以吓得人心脏骤停……

“这是最后的机会了。”

“开启此处小世界，耗去了这五万年来偷偷攒下的所有神魔之力，此举若夺舍失败，本帝或将陷入永久沉眠。”

“九尾天狐血脉…完美的夺舍之躯。”

九层玉台上。

香香已经化为本体，稳稳的踏足第九层。

在她前方的半空中，漂浮着一个巴掌大小的狐形印记，上隐隐散发着让人窒息的大帝之威。

“那就是帝术传承？”香香狐躯轻颤。

她步步上前，抬起爪子想要抓住狐形印记。

但，印记看似很近，却仿佛存在于另一空间，它的爪子抬起，却无论如何也触碰不到……

“怎么会！”

她不断用力，爪子上包裹着灵力，竭尽全力想要洞穿重重空间。

体内灵力飞速流失，但距离那弧形印记始终有着一点距离……

灵力流失得越来越快，香香的狐躯抖得也越来越厉害，意识渐渐出现了短暂的疲惫。

就在此时——

九层玉台上，突然爆发出一股强横的灵魂冲击。

香香一个不防备，脑袋一晕，陷入了短暂恍惚。

同一时间，一道黑色的灵魂之力，无声无息地钻入了她防线大开的灵魂当中……

黑色灵魂之力，看着香香灵魂中的景象，呼吸骤然停滞。

眼前灵魂中央，竟是伫立着一道身影，一道银发飞舞妖异俊美的男人身影。

“蠢货！”

“堂堂九尾狐族血脉，未来注定成帝，竟会将一个人类男人烙印在灵魂当中！”

“既然你喜欢男人，那本帝便用男人，来攻破你的灵魂防线！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The small secret world is shrouded in mysterious fog.

Within the range visible to the naked eye, there is only the nine-story jade platform floating in mid-air.

Behind the thick fog that is invisible to the naked eye, the world here is boundless, and a terrifying figure more than 10,000 meters high supports the world.

This figure is in the form of a human female, with a tall and explosive figure.

She is not a spirit beast of the fox clan, but she is the first to be born with a pair of black fox clan ears, her eyes are pitch black with double pupils, and thick waterfalls of black silk are flying freely behind her head.

She was dressed in tight black clothes, without any charm of the fox clan, and her whole body was filled with the aura of domineering gods and demons.

At this moment, the woman stood with her head on the ground, her palms resting on her head.

The nine-layered jade platform suddenly floated in the palm of his hand, like an exquisite little plaything.

But the two fox shadows on the nine-story jade platform were smaller than half a speck of dust.

If the fog clears, these terrifying scenes are enough to scare people into cardiac arrest...

"This is the last chance."

"Opening the small world here consumes all the power of gods and demons secretly accumulated over the past 50,000 years. If this attempt to seize the body fails, this emperor may fall into a permanent slumber."

"The bloodline of the nine-tailed sky fox...the perfect body to seize the body."

On the nine-story jade platform.

Xiangxiang has turned into its own body and has firmly stepped onto the ninth floor.

In mid-air in front of her, there was a palm-sized fox-shaped mark floating on it, faintly exuding the suffocating power of the Great Emperor.

"Is that the inheritance of imperial arts?" Xiangxiang Fox's body trembled slightly.

She stepped forward and raised her paws to grab the fox-shaped mark.

However, the mark seems very close, but it seems to exist in another space. Its claws are raised, but it cannot be touched no matter what...

"How could it be!"

She kept exerting force, her claws were wrapped with spiritual power, and she tried her best to penetrate the various spaces.

The spiritual power in the body is lost rapidly, but there is always a little distance from the arc mark...

The spiritual energy was lost faster and faster, Xiangxiang's fox body was shaking more and more violently, and her consciousness gradually became temporarily fatigued.

At this moment——

On the nine-story jade platform, a powerful soul impact suddenly erupted.

Xiangxiang was unprepared, her head was dizzy, and she fell into a brief trance.

At the same time, a black soul power silently penetrated into her soul, whose defenses were wide open...

With the power of the black soul, looking at the scene in Xiangxiang's soul, his breathing suddenly stopped.

In the center of the soul in front of him, there was actually a figure standing, a figure of a man with flying silver hair, an enchanting and handsome figure.

"Idiot!"

"The majestic nine-tailed fox clan bloodline, destined to become an emperor in the future, will actually imprint a human man into his soul!"

"Since you like men, then I will use men to break through the defense of your soul!"
